config.notes: Fixed before first inference comparison. No tuning, no claim of smartphone or assistive performance. Perturbations are synthetic transforms of real photographs.

environment.delegate: CPU; MediaPipe default XNNPACK; task API exposes no num_threads setting
environment.caveat: Desktop, mains power; concurrent build processes may affect timings. Phone performance not measured.

timing_scope: Synchronous detect() call, including native resize/normalization/inference/postprocessing; excludes disk decode and mp.Image creation. P95 exploratory with 80 samples per variant; P99 omitted.

input_snapshots.note: Model license provenance clarified in models/NOTICE.md after the run; model bytes and SHA256 unchanged.
